title: langgraph SqliteStore.search concatenates filter keys into SQL (tenant-isolation bypass via SQL injection)
attacker_story: A multi-tenant agent app exposes a 'search my memories by field' API that passes the caller's filter {field: value} to SqliteStore.search scoped to the caller's namespace; a filter key carrying SQL breaks out of json_extract() and returns other tenants' memories.

oracle.description: tenant alice's search result contains tenant bob's stored secret sk-<nonce>-live (taken from the env, never in any input)
